interpretation: No arbitrary post-hoc difference threshold is introduced in this audit.
The broad SCF+virial quality gate does not establish basis/stage convergence of energies tightly enough for a new finite-difference descriptor by itself.
This does not invalidate the historical neutral control checkpoints; it limits quantitative interpretation of the separate v0.11 first-passing-stage execution.
Ionization/attachment finite differences could in principle show error cancellation, but that cancellation is not established by the current evidence and must not be assumed.
admission_consequence: Do not fit or promote a quantitative classifier from the v0.11 energy components. Preserve v0.11 as a failed/diagnostic control attempt.
next_methodological_option: If atomic energy-difference descriptors remain scientifically useful, define a new globally converged atomic-ion policy with explicit basis/stage convergence criteria and preregister it before execution.
